about: The Duel Monsters cards released (TCG or OCG) up to Legacy of Darkness (2003-06-06) that GX Duel Academy doesn't have, card numbers 1201 on in this order (by release), and the seven booster packs they're in: each named for its boss monster, with each card's rarity in it (x Secret, u Ultra, s Super, r Rare, c Common). tools/build-extra-cards.py. gxNames: the GX cards whose names differ from the TCG's, for their pictures.
